title: TRDP: fix bad UI-function-call, switch to libxml, merge CRC use
description:
After discussion in previous MR !22414 

* xml-parsing has been rewritten to libxml.
* The sub-file for dictionary parsing has been merged to a single file.
* The bad use of a UI function has been solved by proper handling field deregistration.
* CRC functions were merged with existing crc library.

Other changes:

* In the XML-data reference the arbitrary IDs were removed to avoid clashes with user defined datasets.
* Custom checksum fields are converted to the standardized fields.

`strsep` is of BSD origin, and not available on Windows.
You could probably do something with `g_strsplit_set`. (There's a `wmem_strsplit`, but no one has implemented a `wmem_strsplit_set`.)
In the previus iteration I included strsep code as it is quite small.

`wmem_strsplit` would be a proper replacement in a next iteration, as syntactically only "," is required to split - ":;" should just catch "suboptimal" syntax. I wasn't aware of the limitations of strsep. In any case (just to note, out of question here) strtok() could not be used as empty tokens do occur.
